name: SAKU 2026
implementation: HORS-V2 literal drawing with HORS-V3 shared colour plan

color_policy.color_encoding: shared addresses plus absolute colour bytes

interactive_cart.rotation: cursor left/right and joystick ports 1/2 left/right
interactive_cart.background_override: replace original black nibbles only; nonblack surface colours are unchanged

keys.F2: white flash, reset black background, follow border, auto off, default rate
keys.Shift+H: pause/open or close help; Space also closes; return to intro until SPACE starts playback
keys.RUN/STOP (Esc in VICE): pause/open or close help; Space also closes; return to intro until SPACE starts playback
keys.Shift+I: toggle bottom-left name and vertex/edge counts
keys.Shift+F: toggle FPS and speed feedback; speed controls remain active
keys.Shift+U: hide all HUD text, or show all when hidden (including INTERACTIVE)
keys.Shift+T: solid source colours, white background, stars off, axis spin
keys.Shift+W: same white-background axis presentation as Shift+T
keys.Shift+G: source-colour gradients, black background, stars on
keys.F3: next foreground hue overlay; cycle back to source colours
keys.Shift+B: toggle card / gradient presentation, preserving spin/crawl and starfield on/off state
keys.Shift+O: toggle outline / gradient presentation, preserving spin/crawl and starfield on/off state
keys.1: reset density for current starfield (light 8 / full 16)
keys.4: switch light / full starfield; preserve each density and on/off state
keys.5: exhibition on/off; hide HUD/stars on entry, restore previous on/off states on exit

interactive_cart.cycle_clock: PAL raster ticks; at most one event per produced sample

speed.hold: extra wait proportional to just-completed production time; starfield IRQ continues
speed.max_feedback: WOW! then white/red SPD.MAX text flash

lines: SHIFT+T / W   solid on white, no stars
SHIFT+I       name and V/E counts on/off
help.startup: original build screen waits for SPACE; press SHIFT+H for help on the row above
pages: SHIFT+T / W   solid on white, no stars
SHIFT+I       name and V/E counts on/off
Star keys still work. Help pauses timer.
help.navigation: C64 cursor right / Shift+cursor right (left); host arrows in VICE

header.implementation: reverse ROM glyphs; event-only color RAM writes

help.pause: producer and raster IRQ pause; bitmap buffers and presentation settings preserved
help.idle: RUN/STOP reuses density row7: 9 extra CPU cycles per idle input poll, no new CIA read

hud_visibility.implementation: key-event bitmap clear/restore across three slots; patch drawing entry points to RTS
hud_visibility.idle: no added rendering branch; small release-latch update in existing unshifted input scan

exhibition.clock: PAL raster clock; scene selection deferred to safe producer/input boundary; help pauses clock
exhibition.stars: on/off defaults to off on entry; manual choices persist across scene switches; profile and density retained
exhibition.hud: off on entry; previous visibility restored on exit
exhibition.single_loop: continues the existing animation if only one loop was compiled
exhibition.ram: reuses spare HUD/help RAM; 1 KiB additional packed help storage at $c000
exhibition.random: 8-bit LFSR, modulo selection excludes current style; not uniform cryptographic randomness

hud_visibility.implementation: key-event bitmap clear/restore across three slots; patch drawing entry points to RTS
hud_visibility.idle: no added rendering branch; small release-latch update in existing unshifted input scan

background_effect.name: starfield-forward
background_effect.implementation: eight hardware sprites; precomputed perspective paths in RAM
background_effect.clock: PAL raster IRQ; independent of object rotation
background_effect.occlusion: sprite priority plus suppress stars in cells whose low colour is not background
background_effect.opaque_occlusion: conservative per-picture painted bounds; hides stars behind black paint and card interiors

density.motion: Points share up to eight sprite trajectories; denser settings form small groups.
density.masking: The whole sprite group is suppressed if an extra point crosses opaque paint, a filled colour cell or the viewport edge.

profiles.switch: IRQ call operand and sprite patterns changed only on key events; both kernels already in RAM

surface_fill.color_mapping: nearest VIC-II palette; weighted CIELAB (0.5 L squared + a squared + b squared)
surface_fill.cell_mapping: weighted CIELAB error; two colours per cell
surface_fill.lighting: flat Blinn-Phong; each nearest source colour selects its native hue ramp
surface_fill.native_limit: two colours per 8x8 cell; black preserved at silhouettes

svg.geometry: disjoint alpha-mask rectangles and boundary walls; no hole-filling fan
svg.opacity: binary coverage at threshold; partial paint composited on black
